output.summary: The function processes an input buffer using a bitwise transformation and returns a 64-bit result.

claims.text: The function applies a bitwise transformation to each byte of the input buffer.
The function uses a nested loop structure: an outer loop iterates over each byte of the input buffer, and an inner loop processes each bit of the byte.
The function does not modify the input buffer.
The function does not modify the output buffer.
The function returns a 64-bit value computed from the input buffer.
The function uses the constant 0xedb88320 in its bitwise transformation.
The function uses the constant 0xffffffff as the initial value for the hash.
The function returns the bitwise complement of the computed hash value.
